page.notes: The Greek phrase in "Commentarij noui" (line 5 of the left column) is worn; the letters after κατὰ τὰ are not legible, so the rest of the Greek is marked. "Confcito" at the foot of the left column may read "Conscito"; left as seen. The catchword at the lower right is cut off by the page edge and is uncertain. The entry "Connubium à contubernio" and the references "157.lz." are copied as printed. Long s is written as s throughout. No page number and no signature are visible.
